projects.title: PalomaMed GenAI Project
projects.summary: Generative AI-powered search tool for veterinary medications using agentic RAG techniques.
description: PalomaMed is a generative AI-powered search tool built to help users find and understand veterinary medication information through natural language queries.

The project applies agentic RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to combine structured medication data with LLM-powered reasoning, enabling more accurate and contextual responses than a standard keyword search.
Note: The live database is currently disabled, but the application shell and UI remain accessible for demonstration.
highlights: Agentic RAG architecture for veterinary medication search
Full-stack web application with modern UI

projects.title: Discount Card Analysis
projects.summary: Analyzed variation in discount card prices by pharmacy type, median income, and insured-to-uninsured ratio.
description: This project examined how prescription discount card pricing varies across retail pharmacy types, neighborhood median income levels, and insured-to-uninsured population ratios.
Data was collected from GoodRx, SingleCare, and ScriptSave WellRx across 12 pharmacies in 4 zip codes, covering 16 different drugs in the United States.
Findings were presented at a faculty seminar in October 2022.
highlights: Multi-source data collection from 3 discount card platforms
Socioeconomic and pharmacy-type price variation analysis

projects.title: Mid Year Data Analysis

description: Python was used to collect, clean, and filter Mid-Year data from the ACCP residency and fellowship directory.
Results were published on Tableau Public to visualize pharmacy residencies and fellowships per region.
Methods and reproducible code are available on GitHub.
highlights: Automated data collection and cleaning pipeline

projects.title: GoodRx Analysis
projects.summary: Scraped, stored, and analyzed GoodRx medication pricing data.
